method: Each identity received a broad dated financing search, a company or registry/history review, and investor, owner or transaction-party checks. Candidate sources were opened and reconciled to the actual issuer. Missing database rows and aggregator omissions were not treated as evidence of zero funding.

This catalogue identity is an Airbus division. Customer aircraft financing and parent-level funding were not misassigned as financing received by Airbus Helicopters.
